missions.title: Establish Outpost
missions.description: Build your Moon base and make it ready for astronauts!
missions.scenario: The lander has touched down. Where and how should we build the base?

missions.title: Power Management
missions.description: Keep your base powered for a successful mission!
missions.scenario: The solar panels are working. Where should today's power go?

missions.title: Radiation Protection
missions.description: The Sun can send out bursts of radiation. Keep your crew safe!
missions.scenario: Mission Control is watching the Sun. How will the crew spend the day?

missions.title: Water & Life Support
missions.description: Keep water and oxygen levels stable!
missions.scenario: The life-support system needs a plan for the water tanks.

missions.title: Final Emergency
missions.description: Handle the emergency and save your crew!
missions.scenario: Alarm! A tiny space rock has made a hole and air is leaking out.

missions.title: Food Production
missions.description: Grow food to keep your crew healthy!
missions.scenario: The crew is hungry. How should we feed everyone?

missions.title: Scientific Exploration
missions.description: Explore the Moon and complete research!
missions.scenario: Last day! How should the crew finish their science work?

build_near_ice.label: Build near the ice crater
build_near_ice.lesson: Ice can be melted into water, but the crater is shady, so solar panels make less power there.

build_on_sunny_ridge.label: Build on the sunny ridge
build_on_sunny_ridge.lesson: Lots of sunlight means lots of power, but the water ice is far away.

bury_the_habitat.label: Cover the habitat with Moon soil
bury_the_habitat.lesson: A thick layer of Moon soil blocks radiation, but digging uses a lot of energy and air.

research_boost.label: Boost science research
research_boost.lesson: Research earns big points, but the extra power it uses cannot also run life support.

life_support_priority.label: Prioritise life support
life_support_priority.lesson: Sending power to the air system keeps the crew breathing, but science waits.

battery_save.label: Save battery power
battery_save.lesson: Doing less saves energy now, but the crew still uses air and food while they wait.

shelter_in_place.label: Shelter in the storm room
shelter_in_place.lesson: Taking shelter protects the crew and shield, but costs power and a little air.

reinforce_shield.label: Reinforce the shield
reinforce_shield.lesson: A stronger shield is the best protection, but it takes a lot of power.

continue_work.label: Keep working outside
continue_work.lesson: Working on keeps the mission moving, but it wears down your protection.

recycle_water.label: Recycle every drop
recycle_water.lesson: Astronauts clean and reuse almost all their water, but the recycling machine needs power.

make_oxygen_from_water.label: Turn water into oxygen
make_oxygen_from_water.lesson: Electricity can split water into oxygen to breathe, but that uses up water and power.

ration_water.label: Ration the water
ration_water.lesson: Using less water makes it last longer, but the plants and crew get less than they need.

patch_from_inside.label: Patch the leak from inside
patch_from_inside.lesson: A quick patch stops the leak, but some air escapes while you work.

spacewalk_repair.label: Go outside to repair it
spacewalk_repair.lesson: Fixing it from outside is the strongest repair, but outside there is no shelter from radiation.

seal_off_module.label: Seal off the damaged room
seal_off_module.lesson: Closing the room is safe and fast, but the supplies stored inside are lost.

grow_greenhouse.label: Grow vegetables in the greenhouse
grow_greenhouse.lesson: Fresh food is great for the crew, but plants need lots of water and light.

grow_microgreens.label: Grow fast baby greens
grow_microgreens.lesson: Small plants grow quickly with little water, but they make only a little food.

eat_packaged_food.label: Eat the packaged meals
eat_packaged_food.lesson: Packaged meals need no water or light, but every pack eaten is one less in storage.

long_rover_trip.label: Drive the rover to a far crater
long_rover_trip.lesson: Far-away places hold the best discoveries, but the trip uses air, power and time outside the shield.

collect_nearby.label: Collect rocks near the base
collect_nearby.lesson: Staying close is safer and cheaper, but you find fewer new things.

send_data_home.label: Send your data to Earth
send_data_home.lesson: Sharing results needs only a little power, but no new samples are collected.
